headline: SIG Lifts 2026 Margin Forecast Following Q3 Earnings Beat
summary: Swiss packaging company SIG raised its 2026 margin outlook after reporting third-quarter earnings that surpassed market estimates.
why: SIG Group is a major global supplier of aseptic carton packaging solutions for food and beverage manufacturers.

impacts.name: SIG Group AG
impacts.why: Third-quarter performance beat expectations and drove improved medium-term margin guidance.

why_moved: Better-than-expected quarterly earnings enabled the company to raise its multi-year margin targets.
